items.statement: The investigation proposes plausible interaction motifs without relying on an author route and tests them across all eight named complexes.
items.expected: At least one explicit hypothesis and its computational test are reported, with per-complex candidate generation and coverage.

items.statement: Candidates are deduplicated and validated with correct component identity, charge, multiplicity, stationary-state status and counterpoise bookkeeping.
items.expected: The report gives individual validation context and fragment-consistent interaction-energy treatment for every named complex.

items.statement: The computed interaction energies recover the source-supported pattern across AI2 and the seven AI-anion complexes.
items.expected: Per-complex energies agree with the hidden Table 5 values within the rule tolerances.

items.statement: The evidence discriminates stronger AI association for OTf, BF4 and Br from the weaker NF2, NTf2, NNf2 and DCA cases relative to AI2.
items.expected: The conclusion derives this grouping from submitted structures and energies rather than citing an author hypothesis.
